svg.title: Investment Dependency Chain
svg.desc: Left-to-right dependency flow showing organizational investments required for each zone transition, organized in four panels. Investments compound: each transition requires everything from the previous transition plus new investments. Critical path highlighted in magenta.
svg.text: Organizational investments compound across zone transitions — each builds on all previous investments
Foundation — remove barriers, establish habitual tool use
Mostly parallel investments. Policy enables everything else.
Critical path: One Team Setup → Quality Gates → Workflow Training
Critical path: AI Engineer Role → CAT → Cross-Functional Training
Critical path: Reorg → Factory Infra → Governance → Risk Mgmt
Each zone transition requires all prior investments PLUS new ones.
Zone 4 requires 29+ investments plus cultural transformation.
The right zone is the one your investment capacity supports.
Investments are what the organization provides. They are the prerequisite for every team-level activity that follows.
Strategically simplified for leadership. See the full 29-investment catalog for complete dependencies.
The pattern matters more than the details: investments compound, and each zone requires sustained commitment to all prior zones.
